_comment: Every scene the Godot build ships must be classified here so a screen that a keyboard/controller player cannot operate can never ship unnoticed (2026-07-25 playtest: 'forbid screens that cannot be operated by keyboard/controller, and set up a Gate'). verify_controller_coverage.gd fails if any res://scenes/*.tscn is missing from this map, if a 'covered' entry names a verify script that does not exist, or if an entry points at a scene that no longer exists. 'todo' entries are the visible, tracked debt — a screen that is reachable and interactive but has no controller verify yet.

boot.tscn.reason: Transient loader — _ready prints the pack and calls SceneManager.goto(title). No player choice, nothing focusable.

config.tscn.reason: Not a reachable standalone route: settings render as a panel INSIDE title.tscn (covered by verify_front_controller's 設定 open/close check); nothing changes scene to config.tscn.
